forest-ink.$description: Forest Ink — Primary brand color, header background, nav bar fill, section dividers, footer — deep teal-green against warm cream creates agricultural gravitas

vivid-lime.$description: Vivid Lime — Promotional marquee strip, highlight announcement bars, occasional link hover wash — the only high-energy accent in the palette

bone.$description: Bone — Page canvas, base background — warm off-white replacing pure white to feel organic and printed

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Card surfaces, input fills, button text, icon backgrounds — the bright counterpoint against bone canvas

ash-gray.$description: Ash Gray — Secondary card surface, subtle section dividers

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Primary body text, headings on light, icon strokes — near-black for high contrast on cream

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary text, link borders, button borders, subdued UI outlines

pewter.$description: Pewter — Muted helper text, tertiary button text and borders

sky-card.$description: Sky Card — Decorative card surface — one of the quilted pastel tiles used for partner testimonials and category blocks

peach-card.$description: Peach Card — Decorative card surface — warm pastel tile alternating with sky and sage cards

sage-card.$description: Sage Card — Decorative card surface — soft green pastel tile for agrarian category blocks

moss.$description: Moss — Subtle borders, input outlines, decorative dividers within body content

inter.$description: Primary UI and body sans. Handles everything from 12px nav metadata to 80–90px hero display. Negative tracking tightens display sizes; positive tracking (+0.025–0.029em) opens up small caps and badge text.

reckless.$description: Display serif for editorial headlines. At 57px the light weight (300) feels literary and unhurried; at 500–600 it becomes section anchors. Tight tracking (-0.012em) keeps the serif sharp at large sizes.

recklesslight.$description: Ultra-light serif variant for body-leading headlines and pull-quote copy. The 100 weight at 25–28px creates a delicate editorial voice in supporting sections.

sans-serif.$description: sans-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
